correctness.rationale: The graph predicate on all 2^21 labeled seven-vertex graphs is tested by all domination sets of sizes 1,2,3. Re-execution of the inspected artifacts/verify.py returned VERIFY_OK: face-size histogram (1,21,210,1330,4515,7077,3605,630), 17388 nonempty faces, 83895 full Hasse covers; sequential toggle 8210 disjoint pairs and a full topological sort give acyclic critical cells (1 in dim0,847 dim4,120 dim5). Integer Morse boundary has exact rank 36 and a displayed 36x36 determinant -1. Therefore all 36 nonzero Smith invariants are units; the 4-skeleton is simply-connected wedge S4 and Hurewicz/elementary CW cancellations give 811 S4 and84 S5. F2 chain ranks independently in verifier are consistent, not standalone wedge proof.
